config.name: m5_stack
config.declared: M5 stacking (DESIGN §5) of m1_E_resB0, m2n_E_paralogs and g3_m3n. Per outer fold: 5 patient-grouped, lineage-stratified inner folds of the training lines (seed 20261026, the splits of the cached M1 inner OOF); inner out-of-fold predictions of each input on the training lines; per training-fold gene class (non-variable; variable x common-essential / selective / other) non-negative least squares of the training targets on the inner OOF predictions, per gene centred and scaled by 1/SD(y), weights normalised to sum 1 (classes with < 20 genes use the pooled variable-gene weights); inputs refitted on all training lines and combined. Baseline: plain average m5_avg. Rung representative: m5_stack if its paired dP1 vs m5_avg > 0 and > 1 fold SE, otherwise m5_avg (stacking adds nothing over averaging). The representative replaces m1_E_resB0 only under the DESIGN §4 rule vs m1_E_resB0 (paired fold-wise dP1 on dev-wide variable genes > 0.005 and > 1 fold SE). DEVIATION D-M5-1 (declared before any M5 run): fully nested inner OOF for M2 needs a third level of M1 fits (25 per inner split, ~650 fits, projected > 5 h with M3), so the M2 inner fits choose their local lambda by the non-nested inner-fold CV of G2 (nested_lambda=False) inside the inner-training lines; this is leak-free with respect to the inner-held-out lines, but the weights are learned on predictions of this slightly different M2. M1 inner OOF: exact-key cache cache/m2_inner. M3 inner fits: exact (nested_es=True). Time box 5 h wall from the launch of m5_stack; if its fold 0 takes > 55 min (projected > 5 h incl. the average and control runs), it is stopped and replaced by m5_stack_f1 (fallback F1: M3 inner fits with nested_es=False, i.e. the un-nested early stopping, logged as deviation).
